estimates: The main footprint follows the named OpenStreetMap building. The official heritage boundary establishes the immediate site and supports the location of associated minor volumes. Where no independent footprint survives, the minor-volume positions are estimates inside that area.

The main heights, eaves, paint tones and position of individual windows, stairs and service fittings are estimates from the written descriptions and mapped dimensions. Closed interiors and below-grade service rooms are outside the exterior scope.
The original 5 m terrain is preserved. Fine platform and paving geometry may differ from the survey.

review.notes: Checked the displayed Qualla imagery first. The exact candidate photographs for the compound use attribution licences. Reconstruction uses historical descriptions, official geography and original terrain. No reference imagery used.
